verses: I also saw souls who were thrown under the feet of cattle, struck by the horns, and their bellies torn, and bones broken; and they were groaning.
And I asked thus: 'Who are these people?'

Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, said thus: 'These are the souls of those wicked, by whom, in the world, the mouths of beasts and ploughing cattle were muzzled; and water was not given to them in the heat; and they were kept at work hungry and thirsty.'
